entities.name: Nani Oula
entities.description: A witch of the Moorlands near Hexenrast in Gavony who mentored apprentices; her soul was trapped in an amulet.

entities.name: Volomir
entities.description: Human apprentice told to slay his family, then fed to werewolves and became a wraith.

entities.name: Gisa Cecani
entities.description: Friend of Volomir and apprentice who received a task.

entities.name: Ulav
entities.description: Madman of Hexenrast and later apprentice.

entities.name: Kurjak
entities.description: Werewolf high shaman killed in Crussebourg, whose soul the Butcher later freed.

entities.name: Vaash Vroga
entities.description: Third apprentice who stole Geralf's masterpiece.

entities.name: Butcher of Crussebourg
entities.description: The Legends planeswalker who served as Nani's apprentice and later confronted her.

events.summary: Nani has Volomir slay his family; when he questions her she feeds him to werewolves.
events.quote: she fed him to werewolves and he became a wraith

events.summary: Ulav presents the traveler to Nani for an apprenticeship.
events.quote: he presented the traveler to Nani for an apprenticeship

events.summary: The traveler massacres werewolves in Crussebourg, including Kurjak.
events.quote: She had the traveler massacre many werewolves in the town, including the high shaman Kurjak.

events.summary: Nani tasks Vaash with stealing Geralf's masterpiece.
events.quote: Nani tasked Vaash with the theft of Geralf's masterpiece

events.summary: The Butcher frees Kurjak's soul and together they trap Nani's soul in the amulet.
events.quote: The Butcher and Kurjak then trapped Nani's soul within the very amulet she had given the Butcher.

relations.quote: Volomir, a friend of Gisa Cecani , was a human apprentice to Nani Oula.
Nani took on Vaash Vroga as a third simultaneous apprentice
The Butcher and Kurjak then trapped Nani's soul
